text:
sarah-ops: quick heads-up — execs want a clear commit plan tying GPU buys to product launches for H2. can we get a proposal by EOW?

devin-enginfra: on it. my draft will include region phasing + a fallback plan (spot vs reserved). question — do we want hard-linked SKUs to launches or a pool abstraction?

matt-product: prefer pool abstraction from product side. launches vary and we don't want model-to-sku coupling. but need SLA guarantees for customers on Dedicated.

olivia-finance: abstraction is nice, but finance needs committed SKUs for discount tiers. reserves drive unit cost assumptions for Q4. can we present both options with delta P&L?

kevin-supply: procurement can do staggered reservations per region. lead times: H100s 16–20w, GH200 quoted 24w for some vendors. if we mix SKUs, shipping coordination gets trickier.

devin-enginfra: noted. proposal will show two timelines: conservative (reserved H100-heavy with buffer) and flexible (smaller reserved + spot/market burst). will map estimated p95 compute latency impact per option.

sarah-ops: include launch gating criteria please — e.g., p95 inference latency <= 120ms for hosted, 95% of requests within target for Dedicated; also cost per 1k tokens thresholds tied to OKR.

matt-product: agree on latency gate. also add \"canary capacity\" requirement: 10% of peak reserved for canary rollouts for 48h. prevents noisy neighbor risks during launches.

devin-enginfra: adding that. one more: autoscale cold-start impact. with reserved-only we get predictable cold-start; with spot fallback we need warm cache policies. I'll add KV-cache warmup checklist.

olivia-finance: please quantify cost delta across realistic traffic shapes: steady-50% utilization vs spike-to-200% for 2 hours. we need to show worst-case burn and monthly committed spend.

kevin-supply: vendor negotiation note — we can push for shorter lead time for a % of order if we agree multi-region split. might shave 2–3 weeks on early tranche. I'll flag vendors that can do that.

devin-enginfra: draft done — sharing GDoc in thread: https://redwood.internal/docs/gpu-procurement-draft (will convert to slide deck). highlights: phased regional rollout (NA -> EU -> APAC), mixed-reserve strategy, canary + warm-cache policy, and clear OKR-linked gates.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: planning doc created by devin-enginfra at 1745007400.

sarah-ops: perfect. next steps: devin to finalize slides, kevin to attach vendor leadtime matrix, olivia to add P&L scenarios. let's sync Thurs 10am for sign-off. :calendar:

matt-product: 10am works for product. placing a draft launch priority list in the doc now.

olivia-finance: adding finance notes. will include sensitivity table and recommended commit range.

kevin-supply: will follow up with vendor LOIs and tentative ship windows before Thurs.

devin-enginfra: thanks team — will circulate v1 slides by Wed EOD and ping for comments.

sarah-ops: thanks. if we want to shift anything to earlier quarter, call it out in the doc with risk notes.

matt-product: will do.

infra-bot: reminder: next sync event scheduled 1745090400 (Thu 10:00).
